sentences.text: Dara Khosrowshahi has served as chief executive officer of Uber Technologies and as a member of its board of directors since September 2017, overseeing the company's business in more than 70 countries.

He was previously president and chief executive officer of Expedia from August 2005 to August 2017, held senior roles at IAC/InterActiveCorp from 1998 to 2005 including chief financial officer, and worked at Allen and Company from 1991 to 1998.

sentences.quote: As CEO of Expedia, Khosrowshahi had been credited with expanding the U.S.-based travel company's global presence through several online travel booking brands, which include Expedia.com, Hotels.com and Hotwire.
sentences.text: At Expedia he was credited with expanding the travel company's global presence across brands including Expedia.com, Hotels.com and Hotwire.

sentences.text: In January 2026 Uber named Balaji Krishnamurthy chief financial officer, succeeding Prashanth Mahendra-Rajah, who stayed as a senior finance advisor to Dara Khosrowshahi through July 1, 2026; Khosrowshahi called Krishnamurthy a decisive strategist trusted by investors.

In May 2026 Chief People Officer Nikki Krishnamurthy stepped down and Jill Hazelbaker, formerly chief marketing officer, became President and Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, taking over Krishnamurthy's duties plus safety operations.
